set -eu
cat > fit_colony.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
result_path <- args[[2]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area")
missing <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ",")))

parse_p <- function(strain, ratio) {
  strain <- as.character(strain)
  ratio <- as.character(ratio)
  if (strain == "98") return(0)
  if (strain == "287") return(1)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- strsplit(ratio, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) != 2) stop(paste("Bad ratio", ratio))
    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
    if (any(is.na(nums)) || sum(nums) == 0) stop(paste("Bad numeric ratio", ratio))
    return(nums[1] / sum(nums))
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}

p <- mapply(parse_p, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
analysis <- d[!is.na(p), , drop = FALSE]
analysis$p287 <- as.numeric(p[!is.na(p)])
analysis$Area <- as.numeric(analysis$Area)
analysis <- analysis[is.finite(analysis$p287) & is.finite(analysis$Area), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(analysis) < 6) stop("Too few analysis rows")

fits <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2), data = analysis),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2) + I(p287^3), data = analysis),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p287, df = 4), data = analysis)
)
aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))[1]
best_fit <- fits[[best_name]]

pred_fun <- function(x) as.numeric(predict(best_fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = x)))
opt <- optimize(function(x) -pred_fun(x), interval = c(0, 1), maximum = FALSE)
edge_x <- c(0, 1)
edge_y <- vapply(edge_x, pred_fun, numeric(1))
candidates <- data.frame(p287 = c(opt$minimum, edge_x), predicted_area = c(pred_fun(opt$minimum), edge_y))
best_idx <- which.max(candidates$predicted_area)
opt_p <- candidates$p287[best_idx]
max_pred <- candidates$predicted_area[best_idx]

summary_out <- data.frame(
  key = c("analysis_rows", "best_model", "best_aic", "optimal_p287", "max_predicted_area", paste0("AIC_", names(aics))),
  value = c(nrow(analysis), best_name, format(aics[[best_name]], digits = 17), format(opt_p, digits = 17), format(max_pred, digits = 17), format(aics, digits = 17)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary_out, file = result_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
